== Description ==
The special 6th birthday of Hay Day is celebrated with a special derby.  Tasks going up to 400 points are part of the derby.  Horseshoe rewards are for three special fences.  Exciting... don't fence me out.. I want those fences too.. yeehaw

To show your support and become a sponsor or make a donation. All donations will go back into the game in giveaways. Be sure you watch the streams for info on when and what the giveaways will be.

https://www.paypal.me/BPorter000
https://streamlabs.com/phoebe

If you are not subscribed to my channel, please do so and don't forget to push the bell to accept notifications to any future videos.
